title: HEAL & MADE Lab Collaboration
summary: With HIT's HEAL and MADE labs, we connect wearable devices, patient apps and a secure central system with AI decision support.
description:
Our work is one link in a wider technology chain built with other Digital Medical Technologies labs at HIT. Together we aim for continuous, data-driven, holistic care that combines three areas:

- **Hardware** — continuous physiological measurements from wearable devices.
- **Software** — subjective reports and measurements from accessible patient apps.
- **Data & AI** — all information collected in secure storage that powers AI decision-support tools.

## HEAL Lab
With the **HEAL Lab** we are developing the **doctor's interface** for DMT++. Data from every app module and partnership is collected in a securely designed central system. HEAL uses it to build an **AI-driven decision-support system**, and therapists view the data as graphs and statistics.

## MADE Lab
The **MADE Lab** builds **wearable devices** and **edge-computing equipment** that collect data from patients' daily activities. Our app-based tools make it easier to collect, process and present that data. They also let patients report their experience with the wearables. Everything is uploaded to the HEAL-developed system.
